text:
alex: :wave: Taking over shift — quick readout (18:05 UTC). Posting current state, mitigations, and handoff asks.

alex: INC-A: rcache-1 write latency spikes since 17:40. Root cause looks like a compaction job thrashing on older SSDs (r-cluster-03). Visible in metrics: write_p95 spiked to ~350ms.

alex: Mitigation done: compaction throttle + routed 20% of writes to replica set rs-2 via smart-routing policy. Latency down to ~120ms.

alex: Next steps: schedule rolling compaction with lower priority overnight, consider relocating heavy writers to rs-4. @jordan can you own the rolling compaction plan?

jordan: On it. I’ll draft the compaction window and post a short playbook in #eng-oncall. Tentative start 02:00 UTC.

alex: INC-B: autoscaler flapping in dedicated-pool-7 caused transient model throttles for model AQC-1 at 16:50. Symptoms: scale-down too aggressive when traffic has sudden bursts.

alex: Mitigation: set min_replicas=3, increased cooldown to 90s, and enabled circuit-breaker for non-critical routes. Also rolled canary to aqc-1-q4 (quantized) for 5% of traffic for critical tenant groups.

maria: Canary metrics look stable so far — latency + token-rate within SLO for the quantized variant. I’ll keep a 15m cadence on the dashboards.

alex: Ask: @priya can you validate that the cost alert thresholds reflect the canary traffic shift? We want alerts if request_cost rises >15% in 30m window.

priya: Will validate now. I’ll update the alert rule if needed and ping once done.

oncall-bot: [ALERT] node r-cluster-07 disk_pressure HIGH at 18:10 — evicting non-critical pods. See: https://internal.ops/redwood/alerts/1925001111

alex: INC-C: r-cluster-07 showing disk pressure after a backup job error. Mitigation: cordoned node, live-migrated user-facing pods to r-cluster-09, cleanup script ran to clear temp snapshots. System stable but we have reduced capacity.

alex: Next step: replace disk on r-cluster-07 during next maintenance window. @devops can you confirm availability for swap tomorrow morning?

devops: Can confirm — I’m scheduled 09:00 UTC maintenance window. I’ll prep replacement and post ETA in this thread.

alex: Ops notes: no current customer-facing degradation. TL;DR: rcache spike mitigated, dedicated autoscaler pinned, disk pressure handled and node cordoned.

alex: Quick runbook snippets in case someone needs them:
```
# cordon and drain
kubectl cordon r-cluster-07
kubectl drain r-cluster-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
# adjust autoscaler
kubectl patch hpa dedicated-pool-7 -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3,"behavior":{"scaleDown":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":90}}}}'
```

priya: Cost alert updated, pushing new threshold to prod alerts. Left a note in the alert runbook about canary weighting. :white_check_mark:

maria: Monitoring: added dashboard panel for aqc-1-q4 error rates and token throughput, 15m refresh.

jordan: Drafted compaction plan, adding playbook link: https://internal.docs/runbooks/compaction-nightly. Scheduling job at 02:15 UTC; will notify 30m before start.

alex: Handing off to @priya for overnight. I’ll be reachable on pager if anything escalates. Main items to watch: rcache write_p95, canary error rate, cluster disk usage.

priya: Taking handoff. I’ll check in at 22:00 UTC with a brief status update. If anything spikes, escalate to @maria first for metrics & @jordan for compaction actions.

devops: Disk replacement ETA posted: 09:00 UTC tomorrow. I’ll also schedule a quick health-check job to run after node comes back.

maria: Acknowledged handoff. I’ll keep the 15m watch on canary panels.

jordan: Acknowledged. I’ll be on-call for compaction window and reachable on slack + phone.

alex: Thanks team. Leaving notes: pager -> priority for INC-A and INC-C, low for INC-B unless canary fails. :thumbsup:

maria: :eyes: good handoff.

oncall-bot: [NOTE] Thread pinned to #eng-oncall for shift handoff reference.
